pnl.name: Nexa Commodities
pnl.root_cause_rev: Q1 FY26-27 net revenue BDT 3.33 Cr against a BDT 8.31 Cr budget — a shortfall of BDT 3.7 Cr (43% achievement): Jul 1.191 vs 1.37 (90%), Aug 0.459 vs 1.79 (33%), Sep 1.206 vs 3.35 (27%). The deficit is supply-driven, not demand-driven. The Malaysia and Thailand import lines that carry the core range were not opened in the quarter, so 56% of finished-goods SKUs (82 of 146) sat at zero stock and three new categories budgeted at BDT 1.3 Cr never traded. A customs branch lock on one Thailand shipment held ~BDT 2.17 Cr of sellable stock for most of July, and a C&F transition that was not F&B-ready produced clearance delays and misdeclared HS codes on 3 of 18 lines. Sell-in was further constrained by credit holds on the two customers who represent ~78% of revenue. Demand was intact — July hit 90% of budget and collections ran at 81% — the business simply had nothing to sell.
pnl.root_cause_loss: PAT −BDT 1.1 Cr against a budgeted profit of BDT 0.34 Cr — adverse BDT 1.91 Cr (Jul −0.386, Aug −0.935, Sep −0.246); EBITDA −0.99 Cr against +0.88 Cr budget. Most of the loss is non-recurring import shock: BDT 87L exceptional cost (BDT 37L demurrage and penalties on a held shipment, BDT 50L from a C&F assessment error that raised Gatorade from USD 1.62 to 8.63) plus a BDT 32.39L NRV write-down. The remainder is structural: volume at 43% of plan cannot absorb fixed cost — August COGS exceeded revenue — gross margin was negative to thin in July–August and only recovered in September.
pnl.plan_rev: Rebuild the range, then hold a steady BDT 2.8 Cr monthly run-rate. Supply is anchored on the approved 5-LC import plan of BDT 11.7 Cr landed (24,185 cartons, 157 SKUs), which carries 19.79% gross margin and 4.97% net margin and is already in execution under CEO approval. Alongside that, widen the channel so the run-rate is not dependent on two accounts: Modern Trade, HORECA, Nexa Essential retail, sole distributorship of high-demand lines and demand-led local purchase. Target state: BDT 2.70 Cr/month sustained from November, ~95% availability on the top-20 SKUs, 60%+ of 69 accounts active against 14 today, top-2 customer concentration below 50%, blended GP 18%, and monthly PAT positive. FY27 revenue lands at ~BDT 29.5 Cr against the BDT 41.88 Cr ABP, which is re-baselined with the Board rather than left as an unachievable number.
pnl.plan_loss: Separate recurring trading margin from exceptional import cost, then price every SKU off true landed cost so a BDT 2.8 Cr run-rate produces a positive bottom line. At the approved import plan's 19.79% GP and 4.97% NP, BDT 2.5 Cr/month yields roughly BDT 0.08 Cr PAT per month. Target state: blended GP 18%, monthly PAT breakeven from November-26, Q3 and Q4 each contributing ~BDT 0.34 Cr, FY27 loss contained to ≤BDT 0.8 Cr against a −5.38 Cr annualized Q1 run-rate, DIO cut from 59 to 45 days, and the BDT 1.20 Cr Q1 loss recovered through trading margin and cost, not one-off gains.

pnl.root_cause_rev: Q1 revenue = 76.4% of budget (0.56 Cr vs 0.81 Cr; −0.07 Cr; Jul 86.6% → Aug 101.8% → Sep 104.5%, Sep = 2.70M = 84.9% of budget). Root causes: (1) the 55.0%-planned Payroll/Staffing pillar was still in setup most of Q1 (the trade-license authority license + payroll-disbursement infra; first staffing revenue only in Aug at ৳1.11M), so the quarter ran on a substitute mix of ~61% Training + ~33% a jobs board resale; (2) 9 of 14 revenue streams stayed inactive (CV/Career Services, BGV, Salary Survey, Employer Branding, Assessment, CV Bank, International/Remote, RMS/ATS SaaS, Premium Subscription = ৳0); (3) employer accounts barely monetized — 7,343 accounts but only 636 verified and ~23–35 paid posts/mo; (4) weak demand conversion — 86% of 'active' flags expired, ~200–232 genuinely live jobs, no self-serve checkout / CRM / GA4 value events.
pnl.root_cause_loss: Q1 EAT = BDT −1.79 Cr (vs −3.37 Cr budget, favourable by 1.16 Cr, but worsening Jul→Sep). Root causes: (1) gross-margin collapse — GP% 104.5% (Jul) → 47.2% (Aug) → 1.7% (Sep); Q1 blended 31.2%; Sep's ~1.7% GP on 0.26 Cr revenue is the driver as mix shifted to low/zero-margin a jobs board resale + one-off training while the high-margin payroll/staffing pillar was still ramping; (2) marketing overspend — Q1 ~BDT 17.49M vs ~8.19M budget (160%), S&M ~4.2× revenue; (3) broken unit economics — CAC ≈ ৳126,400 vs LTV ≈ ৳29,900 (LTV:CAC 0.27 vs 12.60× plan); (4) fixed cost base built ahead of revenue, with 9 of 14 streams inactive and the 55.0% pillar producing ~BDT 0 until Aug.
pnl.plan_rev: Pivot to a Payroll-Staffing-Training-led engine, amplify employer-account monetization, and convert the 9 inactive revenue streams to active. (1) Scale Payroll/Staffing/RPO (55.0% pillar) on 3 models — % of payroll disbursement (4–10%), per-head ৳600–1,200, prepaid per-position ৳500–700 (Model 3) — to ≥৳8.6L/mo (stretch ৳15L). (2) Rebuild Training (corporate + public + government) to ≥৳13L/mo. (3) Monetize the 7,343 employer accounts (636 verified → 1,000+) to ≥৳4L/mo and 300 paid posts/mo. (4) Activate ≥6 of 9 inactive streams (CV, BGV, Salary Survey, Employer Branding, Assessment, CV Bank, International, RMS/ATS, Premium) with first revenue. Target by Dec-26: 20–30L/mo exit run-rate, LTV:CAC 0.27 → ≥0.37, employer retention 18% → 40%, staffing-led high-GP mix.
pnl.plan_loss: Cash-first sequencing + gross-margin repair + spend discipline. (1) Protect working capital first: collections sprint, DSO 60→45 days, receivables 3.5M→≤1.9M, Group salary-float facility term sheet by 31 Oct. (2) Repair margin: shift mix to staffing (VAT on fee-only), pricing lock, commission redesign (2× staffing/posting/CV/BGV, 0.4× a jobs board resale), cap a jobs board ≤15% of mix. (3) Discipline spend: freeze paid jobseeker acquisition while LTV:CAC <1; tier-gated marketing. Target state: EAT loss ≤ budget and trending to breakeven; GP% restored toward 60%+; LTV:CAC ≥0.37 by Dec (path ≥1 by Jun-27).
